from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional
from typing import Literal

class PermitRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single data point extracted from a report's Table 1a for a specific region and month."""
    data_month: str = Field(..., description="The month of the permit data in YYYY-MM format")
    region: Literal["Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West"] = Field(..., description="The census region for this permit volume")
    permit_volume: Optional[float] = Field(None, description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate for total privately-owned housing units authorized")
    percent_change: Optional[float] = Field(None, description="Explicit month-over-month percent change if provided in the report")
    report_release_date: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="The date the report containing this data was released (YYYY-MM-DD), used for precedence rules")
    report_source: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Source document identifier or filename")
    is_preliminary: bool = Field(False, description="Whether this data is marked as preliminary (p)")
    is_revised: bool = Field(False, description="Whether this data is marked as revised (r)")
    methodology_note: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Any noted methodology changes or revision flags affecting data consistency")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    permit_records: List[PermitRecord]
